name: WALLMAN
source:
Just a silly goofy game made over a few days based off of brain rot and a discord conversation.

You needed a place to stay.
You found a house.
You broke in.
You weren't alone...

[From [url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/wallman]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这只是花了几天时间，根据一些无厘头的想法和一段Discord对话做出来的傻乎乎小游戏。

你需要一个落脚的地方。
你找到了一栋房子。
你闯了进去。
里面不止你一个人……

[摘自[url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/wallman]itch.io[/url]]
